sentences.text: 2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 827C of 2024 for the offence registered under sections 498A of the Indian Penal Code and  of Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. Both the parties want short adjournment bringing on record their respective affidavits inasmuch as the contention of the informant is that the petitioner has solemnized second marriage which is being refuted by the petitioner through his learned counsel.
4.
As prayed for, list this case on 19.12.2025 enabling them to file their respective affidavits.

(Rajiv Roy, J) Vijay Singh/-
